title: Scotland: visible red hair vs MC1R gene carriers

source.name: Britain's DNA ancestry-testing study (2013, n=2,343)
source.publisher: Britain's DNA, as reported by Scottish and Irish press

notes: The 2013 Britain's DNA study found about 6% of Scots visibly have red hair in its sample (other sources cite up to ~13% for Scotland depending on methodology), while over 36.5% carry at least one MC1R red-hair gene variant -- rounded here to 37%. The gap exists because red hair is recessive: carrying one copy of the gene does not make it visible.
